license_note: Derived from 17Lands public datasets (17lands.com, CC BY 4.0 per the 17Lands public datasets page). Per-card and per-archetype aggregates computed by this project; not a 17Lands product and not endorsed by 17Lands. Credit 17Lands when you reuse it.

notes.rates: gih_wr/gp_wr/iwd are empirical-Bayes shrunk (see shrinkage.*.archetype_k pseudo-games); gih_wr_raw is unshrunk
notes.cells: a card x archetype cell is listed only if the card was in >= 50 main decks of that archetype; otherwise use the prior: overall.gih_wr - (card's mix offset) + archetypes[b].win_rate, or simply overall.gih_wr + archetypes[b].win_rate - baseline_win_rate
notes.winners: deck_shape_winners = decks with >= 6 recorded game wins (near-trophy in PremierDraft); decks = (draft_id, build_index), 38-45 cards
notes.buckets: color pairs; mono colors; 3-color combos with >= 1% of games; 3c+ = the rest. Splashes count toward the main colors
